items.briefing:
A new study by 1Password has found that AI-generated security patches fail to fully fix vulnerabilities around half the time, meaning organisations relying on AI tools to automatically repair software flaws may still be leaving themselves exposed. This is a good reminder not to assume AI-assisted fixes are reliable without human review.

On a local note, Australian firm DXC Technology has partnered with Primary to launch a new AI-powered Zero Trust security service aimed at Australian businesses. If your organisation is evaluating security upgrades, it's worth asking vendors how they verify any AI-generated fixes before deployment.

**Tip:** Always have a human review AI-suggested security changes before applying them to critical systems.

featured.quote: Defence contractors can reduce compliance overhead using AI-powered compliance tools for federal obligations.
